summary: Defined workflow schema and persistence layer for visual editor state. Created TypeScript interfaces (Workflow, WorkflowNode, WorkflowConnection with input types) in src/types/workflow.ts. Added Neo4j schema initialization with unique constraints and composite indexes for query performance in GraphManager. Implemented WorkflowPersistenceService with full CRUD operations (createWorkflow, getWorkflowById, listWorkflows, updateWorkflow, deleteWorkflow) using transactional Neo4j queries. Exported all types and services from their respective index files.
